summary: ④ Competitive-benchmark research sub-step DONE (dormant until :8787 restart), mirroring ②③'s repo pattern. PART A (storage plumbing): lib/overlay.js (new benchmarks:{} per-task map in EMPTY+exports; setBenchmark(ov,key,data) setter, clears on falsy; load() back-fills via EMPTY spread). daemon.js (validateBenchmark helper near validateMetricSpec; POST /task/benchmark {key,benchmark} to set/clear; benchmark surfaced on task node in buildGraph + /task/detail). lib/mcp-core.js (new set_task_benchmark(task_key,benchmark) MCP tool, before git_init). README + test/benchmark.test.js (new, 19/19) + smoke.sh benchmark section (+9 → 77/77 total). Benchmark record shape: { metric, value(number), unit?, source(string/url), note?, confidence?("low"|"med"|"high"), researched_at? }. Validation: metric/value/source required, value must be a number, confidence∈{low,med,high}; invalid→400 leaving prior benchmark untouched. Absent benchmark ⇒ baseline-only judging (back-compat). PART B (runtime research step): new skill skills/self-learn-benchmark/SKILL.md (same dir/format/frontmatter as self-learn-judge/planner; effort:medium) — reads metric.metric+direction, runs BOUNDED research (deep-research skill or ≤~5 WebSearch/WebFetch), calls set_task_benchmark, DEGRADES GRACEFULLY (records nothing or confidence:"low"+note; explicitly signals "no benchmark — baseline-only" in completion; NEVER fabricates a number). Tests: full unit suite green (benchmark 19, metric-spec 18, measure, repo-target, git, +others all OK); smoke 77/77. RESTART REQUIRED to activate (live daemon untouched, no graph/state mutated, did not run a live research session).
